sn56.90:1.1: la || || Evam eva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye hatthigavassavaḷavāpaṭiggahanā paṭiviratā || atha kho ete va bahutarā sattā ye hatthigavassavaḷavāpaṭiggahaṇā appaṭiviraṭā || la || || Tatiyo Vaggo || Uddānaṃ || ||
sn56.90:2.0: Naccaṃ Sayanaṃ Rajataṃ || Dhaññaṃ Maṃsaṃ Kumāriyaṃ || Dāsī Ajelakaṃ ceva || Kukkuṭasūkara-Hatthino
